scope: Actual paced first ordinary rhythm card for every listed cinematic boss encounter, including repeat visits, from the real bottom-centre spawn through native timeout. This does not cover named spells, complete stages, every seed, prior combat history or human reaction limits.

method.bossHpNote: Only boss HP/maxHP is replenished each card tick to prevent player fire from ending coverage before the existing native timeout. Native duration and all hazards remain unchanged.
method.preparation: Uses prepareBossEntrance and the real 120-tick boss arrival pause. The audit never clears gameplay hazards; normal engine entrance/transition cleanup still runs. Floor, rising objects, mobs and fragments follow actual engine rules.
method.controls: Searches several legal target paths, then a geometric hazard-forecast controller if needed. Each trial advances only one real engine state; a hit fails that trial. Successful full input streams are replayed on a fresh run.
limits: A failed search is not proof that no route exists.
A successful seeded machine route is not proof of universal dodgability or human playability.
The 8-second rhythm may only partially repeat before the native 6–11-second first card ends. No artificial 16-second extension is used.
Normal and Hell use the same rhythm definition; their native card durations and life counts differ.
